title: Sparse quantile index and regional route latency views
creator: Aisha Gupta
description:
Goal: Add stable p95/p99 latency tracking and a compact, queryable index that supports fast dashboards and regression detection per route/model/region. Motivation: existing telemetry pipelines produce heavy raw histograms that are expensive to store and slow to explore for multi-dimensional slices. This ticket introduces a sparse quantile index backed by streaming t-digests and lightweight anchored histograms, integrates it with the load/bench harness (tokens/sec and batch config metadata), and creates a set of dashboards and alerting rules for p95/p99 regressions by route/model/region.

High-level approach: 1) Ingest latency samples from existing telemetry emitter but annotate each sample with route, model, region, batch_profile, kv_cache_hit (true|false), and tokens_in_request. 2) Maintain per (route, model, region, batch_profile) t-digests in time-windows (1m, 5m, 1h) with adaptive reservoir decay; persist sparse snapshots (anchors) each 5m to a compact index (SST-like) for fast range queries. 3) For dashboards, precompute p50/p90/p95/p99 from nearest anchors and merge on read for ad-hoc slices; fall back to raw histogram for very small slices. 4) Regression detection uses two signals: EWMA on p95 delta normalized by median tokens/sec for that slice, and a CUSUM detector on p99 using a baseline window. Combine both to reduce false positives during bursty traffic. 5) Bench harness integration: mark synthetic traffic and attach tokens/sec/batching metadata; add a toggle to replay-loadbench traces tagged as "bench" so dashboards can filter synthetic vs. production.

Data model and storage: - Key schema: quantile_index::{route}::{model}::{region}::{batch_profile}::{time_bucket} - Value: base64-encoded t-digest snapshot + metadata string (sample_count, tokens_sum, cache_hits, schema_version) - Retention: raw t-digest anchors for 30d, aggregated 1h rollups for 90d, p95/p99 rollup for 365d - Storage backend: extend existing telemetry-blobstore with a new compact prefix and small-object optimization to avoid large S3 reads.

Dashboarding and API: - New dashboards in Console: "Latency Explorer: Route > Model > Region" with a pivot UI to show p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec overlays. - Query path for UI: call quantile-index read API that returns anchored quantiles and sample metadata. - Expose a /metrics endpoint for Prometheus-style p95/p99 gauges per route-model-region for short-lived SLO checks and alerting.

Alerting and regression workflow: - Alert rule 1 (Auto-detect): if CUSUM(p99_short_window) exceeds threshold AND EWMA(p95_delta_normalized) > X for 15m then create alert. - Alert rule 2 (SLO breach): p95 > SLO threshold for 10m -> pager on P0. - Alerts contain suggested mitigations: check recent deploys, batch-profile shifts, cache hit rate drop, tokens/sec anomaly, and provide link to bench-replay to validate.

Bench and testing plan: - Extend loadsmith/load-replay harness to produce metadata and flag bench traffic; add knobs to vary tokens/sec and batch_profile. - Run synthetic regression scenarios: kernel change causing 10% p95 regression, batching policy shift, KV cache misrouting, and verify detectors fire and dashboards show correct attribution. - Performance target: index read latency <150ms for common queries (route-model-region last 1h).

Rollout plan: Alpha: internal-only dashboards + bench integration (2 weeks). Beta: opt-in per-customer console groups + alerting (3 weeks). GA: default retention and alerting for enterprise customers (4 weeks).

Notes on tradeoffs: - Using t-digest gives compact quantile summaries but loses full histogram fidelity for pathological distributions; we keep raw histograms for small cardinality slices as fallback. - Anchors every 5m balance write amplification vs read accuracy; can be tuned. - Index growth capped by keying on existing high-cardinality dimensions; if cardinality grows, add sampling by request fingerprint.

Related docs and links: - Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Quantile+Index+Design - Bench harness PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench/pull/462 - Telemetry writer PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/1213 - Dashboard mockups: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qLat-example
acceptance_criteria: Quantile index writes anchored t-digest snapshots at 5m intervals for all traffic annotated with route/model/region/batch_profile
Console dashboards that can display p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec for arbitrary route-model-region slices with UI pivoting
Regression detector that raises alerts for both p95 normalized EWMA and p99 CUSUM with test harness scenarios demonstrating detection
Bench harness emits tokens/sec and batch_profile metadata and dashboards can filter bench vs production
Index read API latency below 150ms for 90th percentile common queries
Documentation and runbook created covering how to interpret alerts and run bench-replay to validate regressions
